source.publisher: Virus Help Team / historical Amiga antivirus ecosystem
source.note: Public historical references describe Zeeball AV-Testfile as a harmless antivirus test file and document that xvs.library added special recognition for it.

provenance.derivation: Research metadata only. No Zeeball archive, file bytes, hashes, signature bytes, or proprietary scanner data are committed.
provenance.verification_required: Obtain the test archive independently from an authoritative source, record exact archive/file SHA-256 values and license/redistribution terms, then derive any AmiGuard test signature from the obtained bytes before promotion.

research.runtime_compatibility_note: Public VHT material associates the test package with AmigaOS 2.0+; this does not establish that the test file itself cannot be scanned as read-only bytes on AmiGuard's Kickstart 1.2 target.
research.promotion_gate: Do not promote beyond research until authoritative bytes, hashes, usage terms, and independent AmiGuard qualification are recorded.
